text:
nidhi: heads-up — saw a weird KV-cache handoff/linger pattern while running long-context repros. memory climbs steadily and we get bursts of pagefaults during token generation. repro on h100 and mi250, behaviour differs but root looks similar.

sam: can you paste the short log snippet? or the repro command you used?

nidhi: here — run was:
```
./tools/longctx_repro --model pagedattn --seq 32768 --tokens 30000 --gpu h100 --kvcache-mode paged --batch 1
```
log excerpt:
```
2026-02-12T14:03:21.213Z kvcache: handoff page 0x7f9b3f authored->ghost linger=12s
2026-02-12T14:03:21.215Z pagetable: pagefault handled, remap->stale_owner=42
2026-02-12T14:03:22.003Z kvcache: evict candidate skipped (refcount>0) id=0x12f
2026-02-12T15:01:12.102Z kvcache: handoff cleanup delayed, lingered entries=17
```
memory: process RSS 2.3GB -> 4.8GB over ~30k tokens, p99 token latency +12ms after 20k tokens.
```

marta: ugh. that "stale_owner" line looks like the pagetable shadow owner wasn't cleared on remap. did we recently change the handoff path?

nidhi: last change was 2 weeks ago — we added the async handoff path to reduce stall on eviction. suspicion: handoff puts pages in "ghost" state until remote ack, but the ack path might not decrement the owner ref in some sequences (paged-attn reuse + repeated remap).

ciara: I can repro locally on mi250 with a smaller token count (10k) if I force smaller page size. Differences: mi250 shows more immediate pagefault spikes, h100 shows gradual RSS growth. might be ordering (nvlink vs pcie) related.

sam: could you run with the tracing flags? add --kvcache-trace=handoff,pt-remap and attach the tiny trace. also enable kvcache invariant checks: `export KVCACHE_ASSERTS=1`

nidhi: trace attached in the thread (shortened):
```
TRACE: handoff-enter id=0x12f owner=55 target=gpu1
TRACE: pt-remap start id=0x12f old_owner=55 new_owner=ghost
TRACE: pt-remap finish id=0x12f status=ok
TRACE: handoff-complete id=0x12f ack_timeout=30s
TRACE: handoff-cleanup skipped (pending_refs=1)
```
notable: finish reported ok but pending_refs remains >0. so the page table mapping changed but ref accounting didn't.

marta: two likely culprits: 1) ack path lost on cross-GPU (race) 2) we decrement refs only on sync path but not when remap moves to ghost. add a fallback to decrement if remap->ghost and pending_refs==0? but need to be careful with double-free.

ciara: quick experiment: patched kvcache to force decrement on remap->ghost when pending_refs>0 and we observed fewer lingering pages but increased brief stalls (we're doing extra atomic ops). statistics: linger_count dropped from ~17 to ~2 in 5 runs, p99 improved slightly but p50 worse by ~1.5ms.

sam: thanks. sounds like a correctness bug + perf tradeoff. action items: 1) add a guarded decrement + telemetry counters (handed_off, linger, remap_decrement) 2) add unit/regression test that simulates async ack drop 3) bisect to find the commit that introduced the new async handoff path for h100 vs mi250 differences.

nidhi: I've created a small repro harness for CI: `tests/kvcache/async_ack_dropout_test.cc` that fuzzes ack order and checks refcounts at end. runs 2000 iterations in ~3m. pushed branch `kvcache/ack-fuzz-314` for review.

perf-bot: CI run on `kvcache/ack-fuzz-314` — 2000 iters — 2 failures (refcount mismatch), both on h100 runners. Logs: /artifacts/314/ref-fail-1.log

marta: assigning sam and ciara to dig into the h100-specific failure. sam can you add the telemetry counters as a first diff? also add a small perf benchmark so we can measure the extra atomic cost.

sam: will do. quick probe results on my rtx test: adding the guarded decrement costs ~0.8-1.2% CPU on the kvcache path, negligible on GPU side. will open PR with counters + unit test.

ciara: I'll reproduce on mi250 with nvlink toggled off to see whether interconnect affects ack ordering.

nidhi: thanks team. I'm leaving the repro logs in s3: s3://redwood-internal/kvcache/repro/3141592653/ . plan: short term: guarded decrement + counters to avoid long-memory growth. long term: rework ack protocol to guarantee ownership transfer without racing refcounts.

marta: add to eng-runtime board and tag oncall for a perf/regression watch when PR merges. :thumbsup:

sam: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kvcache/pulls/424 — includes counters and `KVCACHE_ASSERTS` friendly checks. cc @nidhi @ciara

nidhi: verified local fix reduces RSS growth on both h100/mi250. will run extended overnight test. will update thread tomorrow with final numbers. :rocket:
